summary: Indian regulators can levy environmental compensation on industrial units whose pollution load exceeds permitted limits, scaled by the size of the unit, the severity of the pollution, and how long it continues. Compensation is a polluter-pays instrument, so a longer period of excess emissions increases exposure.

summary: Under India's Perform, Achieve and Trade (PAT) scheme, designated energy-intensive consumers that beat their specific energy consumption targets can earn tradable energy saving certificates, while those that miss targets must buy certificates or face penalties. Wasted fuel from a degrading machine therefore reduces certificate earnings or increases purchase need.
